root_cause.finding: CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore captures fingerprint.receipt_sha256() when the store is opened. In the restart probe the fingerprint is computed before PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, schema initialization and checkpoint writes. The persisted unifieddb_authority_receipt_sha256 is therefore a pre-mutation full-file fingerprint receipt. A fresh process fingerprints the same canonical SQLite file after legitimate WAL/schema/write transitions, so the full receipt differs even though canonical path/device/inode authority is unchanged. Enforcing direct equality therefore creates false-positive authority drift on normal restart.
root_cause.self_reference_note: Using a full mutable DB-content fingerprint as a receipt stored inside that same DB is structurally unsuitable for a persistent authority-binding field: ordinary writes can change the fingerprint, and persisting a refreshed full-file digest is self-referential. This is distinct from the separately-scoped same-inode content/schema refresh discriminator.

repair_hypothesis.proposal: Keep the G2 scope narrow but derive the persisted authority receipt from a stable non-self-referential UnifiedDB authority projection (canonical resolution/path plus file device/inode and authority-source identity as admitted), rather than UnifiedDBFingerprint.receipt_sha256() over mutable file/content/stat/schema/WAL fields. Compare that stable store-bound authority receipt before checkpoint decode/replay. Preserve the separate path/device/inode checks, existing checkpoint digest checks and the exact one-column tamper regression.
repair_hypothesis.required_positive_control: Untampered fresh-process restart must pass before the forged stored authority-receipt negative is credited.
repair_hypothesis.required_negative_control: Mutating only persisted unifieddb_authority_receipt_sha256 must fail closed with CHECKPOINT_DB_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT_MISMATCH before checkpoint decode/replay.
repair_hypothesis.scope_fence: Do not bundle same-inode DB content/schema fingerprint refresh into WP206 G2.

counterhypothesis.statement: Refreshing the full UnifiedDBFingerprint receipt after schema initialization could make the current test fixture pass while WAL remains present.
counterhypothesis.rejection_reason: That approach remains coupled to mutable file/stat/schema/WAL state and cannot robustly serve as a self-persisted stable authority identity across legitimate DB evolution; it also risks silently entering the separately-governed same-inode content/schema discriminator.

coordination.reason: Retained PR647 already owns the canonical G2 mutation lane; this organ records the executable diagnosis rather than racing the same source paths.

next_exact_action: Retained PR647 owner: replace the mutable full-fingerprint self-binding with a stable non-self-referential UnifiedDB authority receipt at the WP206 store boundary; retain exact G1/G2 tamper regression; run WP206 CI on exact new head and require both untampered fresh-process restart PASS and one-column forged-receipt fail-closed PASS before bounded G2 reconciliation.
